baseRequirements.observableExpectedBehavior: Manifest completeness is established under the same omission-challenge discipline this specification imposes on project content. baseRequirements.observableExpectedBehavior: An optional archive is only a transport representation of the same logical container. It must use the registered deterministic archive profile and pass the archive safety rules. The current profile is closed-loop-archive-profile/1: a ZIP archive containing only STORE (uncompressed) entries, entries ordered by canonical-path unsigned byte order, the UTF-8 filename flag set, every timestamp fixed to 1980-01-01T00:00:00, no directory entries, no symlinks or special entries, no archive comment, no encryption, and no extra fields except a Zip64 field exactly where an entry or archive size requires it. The manifest is always at `manifest.json`; the authoritative prompt is at `instruction.txt`; an inbound response is at `response.json`. Directory entries, timestamps, permissions, compression method, compression level, and path normalization are fixed by the registered archive profile. An archive mismatch does not alter the logical package identity; it rejects the transport representation.

All other axes, predicates, and functions are excluded from version 1. A proposition that cannot be faithfully expressed within these registered subsets is not natively representable and routes externally.
